meta.scope: Iran Batch 9 — Tourism, housing/construction, and BRICS / alternative external architecture densification.

candidates.title: International visitor arrivals and tourism statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Cultural Heritage, Tourism and Handicrafts / related
candidates.description: Official statistics on foreign tourist arrivals and related tourism indicators. Arrivals have recovered into the multi-million range in recent Persian years despite sanctions and regional tensions.
candidates.notes: Core tourism statistical product under constrained external conditions.

candidates.title: Housing and construction permit statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on building permits, residential units and construction activity. Housing investment and construction are sensitive to high inflation, credit conditions and urban demand.
candidates.notes: Housing/construction densification of the investment cluster.

candidates.title: BRICS membership and alternative external-architecture framing
candidates.description: Framing of Iran’s formal BRICS membership (from 2024) as part of an alternative external economic architecture aimed at diversifying partners, reducing dollar dependence and mitigating sanctions constraints. Complements the China and Russia bilateral nodes.

candidates.title: Iran tourism–housing–BRICS densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from tourism, construction and partnership sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding international visitor arrivals, housing/construction permit statistics, and BRICS membership / alternative external-architecture framing into a coherent services–investment–external layer.
